description: This file declares the WebAudioPlayerService class, which implements the IWebAudioPlayerService interface. It manages Web Audio Player instances, providing methods to create, destroy, control playback, and query buffer and device info. It interacts with playback service and Web Audio Player factory components.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerService
classes.description: Implements IWebAudioPlayerService, manages Web Audio Player instances, and provides control and info methods.

methods.name: createWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Creates a new Web Audio Player with specified parameters.

methods.name: destroyWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Destroys the Web Audio Player identified by handle.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts playback on the specified Web Audio Player.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses playback on the specified Web Audio Player.

methods.name: setEos
methods.description: Sets end-of-stream for the specified Web Audio Player.

methods.name: getBufferAvailable
methods.description: Retrieves available buffer frames and shared memory info.

methods.name: getBufferDelay
methods.description: Retrieves current buffer delay in frames.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: Writes audio data to the buffer of the specified Web Audio Player.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves device info such as preferred and maximum frames, and support for deferred play.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Sets the volume for the specified Web Audio Player.

methods.name: getVolume
methods.description: Retrieves the current volume of the specified Web Audio Player.

methods.name: clearWebAudioPlayers
methods.description: Clears all managed Web Audio Player instances.
